newsitem.title: USA: BEFORE THE BELL -- Big B rises on offer.
newsitem.headline: BEFORE THE BELL -- Big B rises on offer.

text.p: Big B Inc shares rose to 16-1/8 from 12-5/8 preceding Monday's U.S. market open on news Revco D.S. Inc is offering $330 million, or $15 a share, for the Alabama-based drug store chain.
Big B ended Friday Nasdaq trade with a 5/8 gain, while Revco made no moves from 25-5/8, either ahead of Monday's open or on the New York Stock Exchange Friday.

DII Group Inc fell in early pre-open trade, shedding three to 20 after it said an order slowdown at its DOVatron unit cut second-half revenues by $40 million and fully-diluted earnings per share by $0.35.
Also, Hewlett-Packard Co rose to 44-1/8 from 43-5/8. A source at Cowen & Co said the firm raised the stock to buy from hold, and traders cited the upgrade for the gain.
Phar-Mor Inc and ShopKo Stores Inc said they would merge in a $1 billion stock swap to create a new company called Cabot Noble Inc.
Phar-Mor holders will get one new Cabot share, and ShopKo holders will get 2.4 Cabot shares for each ShopKo share.
Preceding the market open, Phar-Mor shares were bid 1/8 lower to eight while ShopKo was bid unchanged from its 16-1/4 NYSE close and offered at 21, according to traders.
Danka Business Systems Plc American Depositary Receipts soared to 35 from 29-7/8 after its announced the intended acqusition of Kodak's office imaging business for $684 million in cash.
Kodak shares were unchanged preceding the open.
